abstract: Configure and verify reasoning (thinking) output on each inference engine. Covers vLLM --reasoning-parser and thinking_token_budget, SGLang --reasoning-parser and strict thinking, llama.cpp --reasoning-format, --reasoning-budget and --reasoning-effort, TensorRT-LLM, Ollama think, TensorFold and TabbyAPI, the chat_template_kwargs key per model family, reasoning versus reasoning_content, llama-swap and LiteLLM mapping, a probe script and an accuracy-versus-cost gate with rollback.
